Chicken Little.name: Disney's Chicken Little
Chicken Little.summary:
A New Hero Has Emerged!

Save the town of Oakey Oaks from alien invaders! Live the adventures of Chicken Little and his band of misfit friends, master an arsenal of gadgets and power-up and play as commander Ace.

Fancy Pocket.name: Fancy Pocket
Fancy Pocket.summary: Fancy Pocket is a Strategy game, developed and published by Jorudan, which was released in Japan in 2002.

Hudson Best Collection Vol. 2 - Lode Run.name: Hudson Best Collection Vol. 2: Lode Runner Collection
Hudson Best Collection Vol. 2 - Lode Run.summary:
This volume of Hudson Best Collection brings the first two Lode Runner games from the Famicom to the Game Boy Advance:
Lode Runner
Championship Lode Runner

Kiss x Kiss - Seirei Gakuen.name: Kiss x Kiss: Seirei Gakuen
Kiss x Kiss - Seirei Gakuen.summary: Kiss x Kiss: Seirei Gakuen is a Strategy game, developed by Kamui and published by Bandai, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Sum of All Fears, The.name: The Sum of All Fears
Sum of All Fears, The.summary: The Sum of all Fears is a shooter reminiscent of Rogue Spear. The look and feel is alike, although it's simplified in its gameplay mechanics. It is also not a huge departure in comparison to the original version, but obviously converted to a top-down perspective.

Tennis no Ouji-sama 2004 - Glorious Gold.name: Tennis no Ouji-sama 2004: Glorious Gold
Tennis no Ouji-sama 2004 - Glorious Gold.summary: Tennis no Ouji-sama 2004: Glorious Gold is a Sports game, published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Yggdra Union.name: Yggdra Union: We'll Never Fight Alone
Yggdra Union.summary: Yggdra Union: We'll Never Fight Alone is a J-RPG and the second game in the Dept. Heaven series and follows the story of a girl named Yggdra whose family was killed and her kingdom conquered by an empire called Bronquia. Now she must recruit the best warriors from the land in order to regain her kingdom and confront the Emperor of Carnage, Gulcasa.
